t: The Signature Vision: River Bus Networks 2.0
title: The Signature Vision: River Bus Networks 2.0
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of River Bus Networks 2.0.
description:
The Signature vision of River Bus Networks 2.0 does not ask what committees will fund — it asks what physics allows and what engineering can compound.

Signature network hulls program, charter one: master river buses at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale network logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate dock systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what River Bus Networks 2.0 becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

t: 2032 — First certified network hulls service opens: river buses propuls
title: 2032 — First certified network hulls service opens: river buses propuls
definition: 2032 milestone on the River Bus Networks 2.0 roadmap.
description:
First certified network hulls service opens: river buses propulsion carrying paying passengers on network logistics guideways.

What must be true first: the river buses results have to replicate outside the lab, network logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and dock systems operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed river buses demonstrations, network logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting dock systems uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

definition: Estimates River Bus Networks 2.0 readiness from component maturity.

Honest scoring is the point: a network hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: River Bus Networks 2.0 Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates River Bus Networks 2.0 operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a River Bus Networks 2.0 installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 41728 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where river buses monitoring, network logistics redundancy, or dock systems maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: River Bus Networks 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for River Bus Networks 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for River Bus Networks 2.0 — next-gen river bus transit.

Phase 1 — Prove (river buses): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (network logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (dock systems): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (timetables): network hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and cities-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
